title: Influencer
description: A creator's personal-brand site — the flagship of BOTH creator content domains: a link-in-bio hub whose entries render in the owner's order with derived group chips (the business-content contract's links domain — https-only URLs, badges, categories, all editable from Manage without touching code), and a shoppable looks gallery whose filter chips derive from the looks themselves, each outfit carrying its own product links (the looks domain — photographs stay code-owned and join by slug). Around them: a golden-hour hero, the five-platform audience row, honest trust metrics, brand-side testimonials, the creator's two-rules story, and a campaign-inquiry lead form. Five pages, all facts in one content file, art-directed in the editorial register's warm paper with a rust brand.

forms.$comment: Managed-form kinds, formKey -> kind (append-only vocabulary: RSVP | LEAD | MAILING_LIST | PROOFING). Compose stamps these into repobot.deploy.json as formKinds; the dashboard renders declared kinds as typed views and keeps the raw Inbox for undeclared keys.

theme.$comment: The editorial register's warm magazine paper with a rust brand: mode light opens the site in its native daylight appearance, and the rust rides as the project brand so app-side surfaces wear the same register as the marketing pages instead of the kernel default blue. The marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-inks editorial's terracotta into the creator's deeper rust on pages and app alike — the golden-hour street photography's own palette.

contentContract.$comment: The pack's content slots, as data (packs/README.md 'Content contract'). The two structured exports are contract-shaped on purpose: `links` IS the business-content contract's links domain shape (the hub renders in entry order — ORDER IS THE CONTENT — and URLs must be https), and `looks` is the looks domain shape plus each look's code-owned photograph (looksDocument.ts owns the merge; images join by slug and never ride the contract). `category` is each domain's taxonomy axis: a free short label the pages derive group/filter chips from — a composer must keep it short and reusable across entries, never a sentence. Product links are label + https URL pairs, at most 8 per look.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed (repobot.content.json domains this pack ships). links mirrors content.ts's `links` export entry for entry, in the same order — ORDER IS THE CONTENT, the hub renders top to bottom. looks mirrors the `looks` export entry for entry MINUS the photographs — the contract moves words and product links, never bytes; the pack joins its code-owned images back by slug (inventory.ts). The content tests pin both twins, so the composed template's Manage editors open on exactly the hub and gallery the site already shows.

landing.$comment: Doc-aware pack pages: routes maps each pack route to the page id its config merges under (web/app/src/View/Influencer/InfluencerPage.tsx, useSitePageConfig). pages seeds each page's layout skeleton — ids match influencerLanding.ts; the platform's structural editor edits these. The preset is editorial (the magazine register: warm paper, serif display, hairline rules, still motion) — a personal-style creator's own printed page, deliberately apart from folio's cooler portfolio read. The looks page lives at /looks and the hub at /links: both are the pack's own vocabulary, colliding with no other pack's preview route.
